description: UUIDv7 identifier of this object; existing generated IDs are preserved.
Internal source-workflow name identity key retained for traceability.
Source family or consolidated identity origin used to construct the record; detailed contributing sources are retained separately.
Source feature identifier or consolidated river identity key; not the public object UUID.
Single naming scope containing this object; null when multiple scopes apply. Use system_ids for the complete list. River scope uses MAIN_BAS.
JSON naming scopes; a river scope is its MAIN_BAS watershed, not a claim that all tributaries share an identity.
Workflow route (river or lake), not the detailed feature type.
Detailed resolved feature type; river/lake processing routes do not replace this classification.
Resolution of feature classification: resolved, conflicting or unknown. Independent of geographic assignment confidence.
Boolean flag encoded as 0/1: reviewed stream/canal variation within one identity was retained rather than treated as separate incompatible types.
JSON array of normalized feature types at the preferred source tier.
JSON array of original feature codes at the selected classification tier; source codes are preserved.
JSON array of source families supplying the selected feature classification.
Preferred recorded label; never a reconstructed spelling.
JSON array of source-supported primary candidate labels within the object, before final display preference.
JSON array of other recorded names belonging to this name object.
JSON array of recorded source spellings retained for this object.
JSON array reserved for labels alternative in geographic applicability; not proof that they are aliases of this identity.
JSON array of workflow annotations on naming relationships; flags do not by themselves revoke an accepted identity.
Object acceptance: accepted when it has a validated association; unresolved otherwise. Does not imply every geographic association is validated.
Interpretation of the object decision; name_object_has_validated_association means at least one associated candidate was accepted.
fully_validated: all associated candidates accepted; partially_validated: accepted and unresolved candidates coexist; unresolved: no accepted candidate.
Boolean encoded as 0/1 indicating unresolved associated candidates in the source validation snapshot; retained evidence, not an instruction to reopen a closed disposition.
JSON array of internal candidate keys whose association decision was accepted.
JSON array of internal candidate keys whose association decision was not accepted; not assigned geometry UUIDs.
Count of accepted candidate associations for this name object.
Count of nonaccepted candidate associations retained as evidence for this name object.
JSON array of internal validation candidate keys contributing to this object.
JSON array of internal branch or water-body target keys; these are not public geometry UUIDs.
JSON source records, identifiers, spellings, classifications and roles.
JSON array of original HydroSHEDS STRM_ID values supporting river identity; does not include every propagated assignment.
JSON array of connected groups of directly supported STRM_ID values; observation gaps do not create separate name identities.
JSON array of earlier internal component-based identity keys retained for traceability; not current public object IDs.
JSON array of recorded STRM_ID paths and identity-connection evidence; paths do not turn inferred reaches into direct observations.
watercourse: eligible watercourse name; feature_only: localized feature rather than a watercourse name; pending_type_review: type not established for propagation.
JSON array of distinct accepted name objects sharing applicability somewhere; not aliases or identity merges.
JSON references to distinct accepted name objects, scoped to explicit geometry UUIDs; shared applicability is not alias identity.
